nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance and time constant on the thrust stand
nodes.procedure: One station on the H1 stand with the real printed mount, 11x5.5MR, 14.8 V. K-type thermocouples on the stator (through the base vent), between base and mount, and on the bell (IR). From ambient: hover power (~100 W bus) for 10 min, log every 5 s; fit T = T_inf - (T_inf - T_0) e^(-t/tau): R_th = (T_inf - T_amb) / loss, loss = P_in - torque x omega. Then 30 s at 24.8 A. Pass: R_th <= 1.5 K/W, base < 58 degC at hover power from 30 degC (PETG) or < 83 degC (ASA).

nodes.title: ESC on a fin-pad mock-up in the slipstream
nodes.procedure: Foam-board half-fin with a 22 mm tube LE behind the stand prop; ESC strapped on the pad at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the axis, FET side out; thermocouple under the heat-shrink on the FETs. Hover power 10 min, then 30 s at the limiter. Tuft on the pad. Back-solve the wake factor: f = (h_meas / h_model)^2. Pass: <= 70 degC steady at hover power from 30 degC (15 K below the MCU rating).

nodes.title: Temperatures after the first full missions
nodes.procedure: Field ambient from the handheld anemometer/thermometer at take-off; IR on the four motor cans, ESCs and the pack within 60 s of landing; IMU.T and BAT current from the log. Compare with the model re-run at the measured ambient: within +-8 K, else update ASM-E3-RTH-DESIGN / ASM-E3-WAKE.
